title: Meditations
lead: The year’s reading programme: each day its passages and its psalm. Import it from a calendar (CSV), then publish it; the site shows the meditation of the day.
plans_empty_p: Create the year’s programme, then import the Bible service’s calendar.
publish_help: A published programme is visible for the days it covers. Check the passages first.
delete_p: All its days are deleted with it. This is permanent.
no_days_p: Import a calendar or add a day by hand.
readings_help: An ordinary day usually has one reading; a Sunday or feast up to three. Choose the book, then the chapter and verses.
psalm_help: A number alone = the whole psalm. Add “From” and “To” for a part (Psalm 89, verses 31 to 47).
verse_help: The verse is picked among the day’s passages (the first by default); change it if needed. Then type its text in the permitted translation: Louis Segond 1910 for French, World English Bible for English. Without text, no verse is shown.
verse_pick: Passage of the verse of the day
import_help: Convert the Bible service’s calendar into a CSV file (columns: Date, Headline, Reading 1/2/3 Label and Ref, Psalm). The “Day”, “Reflection Theme” and “Status” columns are ignored. A day that already exists is updated. The template shows the expected format; every line is checked before it is imported.
import_blocked: Fix the errors (line shown), then check again.
issue_bad_header: The expected columns are missing (Date, Reading 1 Ref, Psalm…).
issue_unknown_book: Book not recognised in “{d}”: it will be shown as written.
issue_psalm_without_number: The psalm “{d}” is only a verse range: check the psalm number.

site.no_plan_p: As soon as a meditation programme is published, you will find each day’s readings here.
site.no_day_p: The programme does not cover this date.
site.calendar_p: Each day of the programme in your calendar, at the time you choose, with the passages to read. The file is built on your device; nothing is sent.
site.calendar_error: The calendar could not be prepared. Try again.

add_part: Add another passage of the same book
verse_wait: Add a reading or a psalm first: the verse of the day is taken from them.
delete_day_p: Its readings and psalm are deleted. This cannot be undone.
import_outside: {n} day(s) outside the programme’s planned dates ({a} → {b}): they will be imported anyway.
import_skipped: {n} line(s) with an error will not be imported. Fix the file and check again to include them.
